name: @ruokee/omp-smart-context
description: OMP context capabilities for request alignment, compaction usage, and model prompt rules

compactionCacheEnabled.description: Align owned non-Codex Responses V2 remote compaction without changing native maintenance. Off by default; restart to apply.

compactionCacheProvider.description: Exact configured Provider name eligible for remote alignment. Empty keeps alignment inactive; restart to apply.

compactionCacheMode.description: standard reuses recognized native repairs; hooks also reuses proved complete context results. Neither mode enables alignment; restart to apply.

handoffCacheEnabled.description: Align owned handoff side requests with the confirmed online dispatch without changing native handoff generation. Off by default; restart to apply.

compactionUsageEnabled.description: Record soft and handoff usage unless the host records it natively. Restart to apply.

modelPromptsEnabled.description: Append matching model-prompts documents each covered turn. Off by default; restart to apply.
